# Circuit Diagram Generator — Full LLM Context

Site: https://www.circuitdiagramgenerator.ai
App: https://app.circuitdiagramgenerator.ai
Brand: Circuit Diagram Generator
Category: AI circuit diagram generator / electronics schematic design tool

## Summary

Circuit Diagram Generator is an AI circuit diagram generator that converts natural-language descriptions and photos of sketches into editable, simulation-ready circuit schematics. It chooses real parts with correct footprints and pin mappings, supports manual and AI-assisted editing, includes built-in simulation, and exports to KiCad, Eagle, PDF, and SVG.

## Ideal for

- Students learning electronics who want labeled schematics from a sentence
- Teachers building lesson handouts and lab materials
- Hobbyists turning notebook sketches into simulate-ready diagrams
- Engineers moving from idea to schematic quickly before PCB work

## How it works

1. Describe the circuit in plain English, or upload a photo of a hand-drawn sketch / existing diagram.
2. The AI drafts a schematic with real components, correct footprints, and wiring to spec.
3. Review, edit by hand or chat, simulate behavior, then export to KiCad, Eagle, PDF, or SVG.

## Feature detail

### AI circuit diagram generator from text
Users type prompts such as "blink an LED every second with a 555 timer" or "common-emitter amplifier stage." The product returns a complete schematic rather than a high-level block diagram.

### AI circuit diagram generator from image
Users photograph a whiteboard, notebook page, or printed diagram. The AI redraws it as a clean labeled schematic ready to edit or simulate.

### Simulation
Every plan includes built-in simulation so wiring or logic issues can be caught before parts are ordered or boards etched.

### Component library
Parts are selected from a library of real components with accurate pinouts and footprints.

### Editing
Wiring and parts can be adjusted manually. Users can also request changes in chat; the AI updates the schematic while preserving reviewed work where possible.

### Exports
- KiCad project files
- Eagle project files
- PDF for documentation and lessons
- SVG for sharing and embedding
